author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದುರಭಿಮಾನದ ನುಡಿಯು ನಿರಭಿಮಾನದ ನಡೆಯು
ತರಲಿಹವು ಸಂಕಷ್ಟ ಜೀವನದೆ ಸತತ
ಕರಗದಿಹ ವ್ಯಾಮೋಹ ಮರುಗದಿಹ ಮನವಿರಲು
ತರಗೆಲೆಯು ನಿನಬದುಕು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Speech full of false pride, conduct without self-respect,
with infatuation that never melts and a mind that never feels pity,
your life is a dry fallen leaf, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Arrogant words, undignified conduct, clinging desire and a hard heart make life as empty and aimless as a dry leaf in the wind.
